verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents a REST API (/rest/v0), a public OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, and a ReadMe reference with generated per-endpoint language snippets. These are building blocks a developer could use to build their own client, not official SDKs. Nothing in the pack mentions a first-party SDK package or client library in any language, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
